definitions.explanation: Naturally black hair, often with connotations of beauty and elegance in Japanese culture.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧{黒髪|くろかみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{黒髪|くろかみ}⟦ストレート→ストレート：11630_sutoreeto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧だ。
examples.english: Straight black hair has been popular recently.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧{黒髪|くろかみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{風|かぜ}→風：00641_kaze⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なびかせて→なびく：07357_nabiku⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{印象的|いんしょうてき}→印象的：15547_inshouteki⟧だった。
examples.english: The sight of her walking with her long black hair flowing in the wind was striking.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{黒|くろ}→黒：02205_kuro⟧ (black) + ⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧ (hair). In Japanese culture, {黒髪|くろかみ} has traditionally been associated with beauty and elegance, especially in literature and poetry. The word carries more aesthetic weight than simply saying ⟦{黒|くろ}い→黒い：00588_kuroi⟧⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧ (black-colored hair).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧{黒髪|くろかみ}: beautiful black hair
- ⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧{黒髪|くろかみ}: long black hair
- {黒髪|くろかみ}⟦ストレート→ストレート：11630_sutoreeto⟧: straight black hair
- ⟦{艶|つや}やか→艶やか：22288_tsuyayaka⟧な{黒髪|くろかみ}: glossy black hair
- {黒髪|くろかみ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{戻|もど}す→戻す：02317_modosu⟧: to go back to black hair (after dyeing)

CULTURAL NOTE:
In traditional Japanese aesthetics, long, straight {黒髪|くろかみ} was considered the ideal of feminine beauty. This image persists in modern culture, though hair dyeing is now very common.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{白髪|しらが}→白髪：00369_shiraga⟧: gray hair, white hair — often a sign of aging
- ⟦{金髪|きんぱつ}→金髪：14443_kinpatsu⟧: blond hair — natural or dyed
- ⟦{茶髪|ちゃぱつ}→茶髪：14203_chapatsu⟧: brown-dyed hair — common among Japanese youth
